name: DRLVaultV3
rootCause: DRLVaultV3's swapToWETH() performed a swap of USDC to WETH through the USDC/WETH pool without adequate slippage protection (the vault trusts the live pool price / accepts whatever the manipulated pool returns). The attacker took a large Morpho USDC flash loan and used it to massively skew the USDC/WETH Uniswap/Pancake V3 pool price, then called the vault's swapToWETH(100000 USDC); because the vault executed at the manipulated spot price with no real minimum-out guard, it swapped at a wildly unfavorable rate, transferring value to the attacker. After restoring the pool with reverse swaps and repaying the flash loan, the attacker kept ~100K USDT. The root cause is the vault swapping against a manipulable spot pool with insufficient slippage / price-validation. DRLVaultV3 on Ethereum Mainnet was exploited on 10 November 2025 for approximately $100,000, when its on-chain slippage computation enabled an attacker to manipulate the reference swap price and drain value using a flashloan-powered price distortion, followed by a vault swap at the inflated rate. The DRLVaultV3 vault computed minimum swap output (amountOutMinimum) using the spot on-chain pool price, allowing an attacker to manipulate the price in the same transaction and bypass meaningful slippage protection.
